query: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan in 18 months?
ground_truth_answer: According to Section 4.2 of FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual, because the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months, the applicable foreclosure charge is 3.0% of the outstanding principal balance plus 18% GST.

query: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan after 26 months?

query: Can I close my personal loan within 3 months of getting it?
ground_truth_answer: No. Under Section 4.2 of the FinBase Personal Loan Policy, full foreclosure is strictly not permitted within the initial 6 months from the date of loan disbursal.

query: How much part-prepayment can I make without paying any fee?

query: What happens if my monthly EMI bounces due to insufficient funds?

query: What is the minimum credit score required by FinBase for personal loans?

query: What is the auto-reversal TAT for failed UPI transactions and compensation for delay?
